speaker: Old Kings' Cairn
description: An Old Kings' cairn at the Titan's shoulder (plan M6-M9 §5.4, decision 33; P35): reading it once gives one attribute point (once-flag reward.cairn.bones_shoulder).

nodes.text: A cairn on the Titan's shoulder, set there by a hand as big as yours. Its runes: 'Only one who stands as tall as the dead may sit beside them.'

choices.text: [Lay a hand on the stones] (+1 attribute point)

nodes.text: An Old Kings' cairn. Its strength is already in you.
